verdict.rationale: The changelog says `/agents` opens a "session command center", which suggests a single place for overseeing multiple sessions. `byteask queue` can also send messages into a running session from another terminal. Both are one-line changelog mentions with no detail on how multiple sessions are viewed, switched between, or coordinated, so this reads as partial rather than a documented unified workspace. Missing for 10: dedicated docs describing multi-session management in the command center (listing, switching, monitoring parallel agents), confirmation that it works as a unified workspace, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
